full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a solitary person standing near the top of a dark stairway as a broad wedge of light crosses a plain wall. The upper left corner is almost solid black, while a pale triangular plane widens from the lower left toward the upper right. Its edge is sharp enough to establish an unmistakable diagonal yet gently softened by film grain and the texture of the wall. The stairs begin in shadow at the lower left and climb toward the center-right, their individual treads only faintly visible until a thin highlight catches the upper landing. The person stands on that landing close to the right wall, seen in left-facing profile. A short hair outline, head, shoulders, and long dark outer garment are readable, but the face and clothing remain almost entirely without internal detail. A dark vertical strip at the far right closes the frame and makes the figure appear pressed between the wall and the light. The bare plaster or concrete surface within the illuminated triangle carries faint mottling and vertical wear, giving the otherwise minimal composition a physical scale. A small patch of bright floor near the bottom left echoes the top landing and helps link the near and far ends of the stair. The light enters from an unseen opening high on the right, striking the wall and barely reaching the person; deep shadows collect in the stairwell and along the frame edges. The photograph uses fine grain, strong tonal separation, and very few objects. The overall composition turns a simple human silhouette and one diagonal beam into a tense, measured study of isolation and passage.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白照片呈现一位孤身人物站在深色楼梯顶部附近，一大片楔形光越过朴素墙面。左上角几乎纯黑，一片浅色三角平面从左下向右上拓宽。其边缘足够锐利，形成明确斜线，却又被胶片颗粒和墙面肌理轻轻柔化。楼梯从左下阴影中开始，向中央偏右攀升，单级踏面大都只隐约可见，直至顶层平台的一线亮边。人物在右墙附近的上方平台上，呈向左的侧影。短发轮廓、头、肩和长深色外衣可辨，面孔和衣物内部却几乎完全没有细节。最右缘一道深色竖带收住画面，使人物像被夹在墙与光之间。受光三角内，裸露的灰泥或混凝土表面有淡淡斑驳和竖向磨痕，为极简构图提供物理尺度。左下角一小块亮地面呼应顶部平台，也把楼梯近端和远端连起来。光从右上方看不见的开口进入，照到墙面，只微微接近人物；楼梯间和画缘聚着深影。照片采用细颗粒、强烈调性分隔和极少物件。整体构图把简单人体剪影与一道斜光转成紧张而审慎的孤立与通行研究。
style_prompt_en: The photograph uses extreme grayscale contrast, a broad diagonal light plane, and near-black negative space. Structural lines remain spare and exact, while fine grain and faint surface wear keep the light area tactile. A small silhouette at the boundary of brightness gives scale and tension without requiring internal detail. Directional light enters from outside the frame and creates a hard major division; secondary highlights are narrow and restrained. Deep shadows swallow peripheral information, making the eye follow the stepped recession of planes and the bright wedge. The overall treatment is minimal, graphic, and psychologically charged.
style_prompt_zh: 照片使用极端灰阶反差、宽阔斜向受光平面与近黑负空间。结构线条稀少而精确，细颗粒和淡淡表面磨损仍让亮区可触。明亮边界处一枚小剪影提供尺度与紧张感，无需内部细节。定向光从画外进入，制造硬质主要分隔；次要高光狭窄而克制。深影吞没外围信息，使视线沿平面层层后退的关系与明亮楔形行进。整体处理极简、图形感强且有心理张力。
theme_en: A silhouetted person on a stairway cut by diagonal light
theme_zh: 斜光切过楼梯，一位人物化作剪影
name: Shadowed lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
